learning_outcomes.text: Defines basic concepts related to the field of Communication Sciences.
Knows the historical development of communication processes and tools.
Expresses the communication process and the characteristics of the elements involved in the process.
Identifies the importance of culture in the communication process.
Effectively applies the elements necessary for an effective speech.
Can analyze the communication processes they witness.
Gain awareness about their own communication styles.
Can initiate necessary changes in their own communication styles.
Acquire the skill to develop healthy communication in conflict situations.
Evaluates which type of communication to use in all areas of life.
Understands the importance of ethical principles in line with individual and societal goals throughout life, using acquired knowledge, skills, and competencies.

syllabus_topics: Communication skills and personality analysis test applications
